name: completion-opt-in
goal: Keep completion audits explicit and preserve current agent, Desktop and default loop behavior

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Preserve ordinary loop, agent and Desktop completion; require explicit coding or planning opt-in for the new audit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard loop matrix did not assert that a default loop omitted the completion contract. Freeze that assertion before restoring compatibility.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted immutable failing checkpoint 75a99c721a04f4e0219962220b80a1d9a6fb215a; tests were committed before product repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Remove automatic completion hooks and retain only explicit CLI, API and typed-loop audits.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted unchanged-test passing checkpoint 7c6175c67ca14085cfab6593f2ab7af7ad9bcb45 with its retained paired red record.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged default-loop regression passes. Existing activity and Desktop contracts are restored; later focused Task and SDK checks pass.
